Id1.text: The Train song Mermaid was made next to the song This'll be my year. It has a length of 3 minutes and 16 seconds and it is written in the reggae music field. Its followed by the John Lennon song called Imagine.

Id2.text: The band, Train, produced, "This'll be my year" and followed it up firstly with a reggae song, entitled, Mermaid, which lasts 3.16 minutes, and then with a rendition of the iconic John Lennon hit, Imagine.

Id3.text: The Train song Mermaid, which is in the reggae genre, was followed by the release of the band’s cover of Imagine by John Lennon, while it was preceded by the song This'll Be My Year. Mermaid has a total runtime of three minutes and sixteen seconds.
